subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fabulous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fabulous"** means something that is extraordinarily good or wonderful. (अद्भुत)

 
 
• **Example: **The view from the top of the mountain was simply **fabulous.**
 
 
 
• **"Remarkable" **refers to something that is worthy of attention; extraordinary. (उल्लेखनीय)
 
 
• **Example: **Her performance in the play was truly** remarkable.**
 
 

Hence, we can infer that a synonym of **'fabulous' **is **'remarkable'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Resourceful **(साधन संपन्न): Having the ability to find quick and clever ways to overcome difficulties.

 
 
• **Example:** She was very resourceful and managed to solve the problem quickly.
 
 
 
• **Regrettable **(खेदजनक): Causing or deserving regret.
 
 
• **Example: **It was a regrettable mistake that cost the company a lot of money.
 
 
 
• **Restful **(आरामदायक): Providing or conducive to rest.
 
 
• **Example:** The vacation was very restful and relaxing.
 
 

2fe:Tc71,

The correct answer is: **Option 1)**</p
